phase_name: Local Validation Ladder (Re-Execution Over Universal Compilation)

manifest_path_compatibility.reason: The W6.A manifest path is retained for shim compatibility while W12.A re-executes the ladder over the compiled universal PDC.
manifest_path_compatibility.sunset_policy: Record a dated architecture/shims.toml sunset only after the universal capability is production-capable.

quick.description: Run a bounded runtime quality smoke subset for closeout/projection semantics.
quick.next_action: Repair closeout/projection/semantic smoke failures before running the full W12.A ladder.

quick.description: Run a bounded Scientist/Lex/Fabric/Foundry producer smoke subset.
quick.next_action: Repair producer smoke failures before broad unit or cloud validation.

quick.description: Run capability-ratchet and evidence-bundle repo-quality smoke checks.
quick.next_action: Repair repo-quality smoke failures or classify them as local typed blockers.
Repair semantic smoke failures before declaring local validation green.

quick.description: Run the W11.E compilation truthfulness self-test smoke.
quick.next_action: Repair W11.E missed, hallucinated, scope-drift, or authority-drift obligations before using W12 rollout evidence.

quick.description: Run the W11.F domain coverage breadth self-test smoke.
quick.next_action: Repair W11.F domain graph coverage or mark uncovered domains as research-only/held before rollout.

quick.description: Run the W11.F critic ensemble diversity self-test smoke.
quick.next_action: Repair critic monoculture or classify the diversity warning before promotion beyond governed pilot.

quick.description: Run Phase 7 capability graph export, PROV, inspection, and card gates.
quick.next_action: Repair DCAT/PROV/card/inspection generation before treating the capability graph as externally inspectable.

quick.description: Run the local production-debug quick path before cloud lanes.
quick.command: uv run --extra runtime --extra multi-tenant --extra ml python tools/quality/testing/local_prod_debug_probe.py --repo-root . --checks quick,production-data-static,docs-repro --output _build/.tmp/production-quality/universal_pdc_local_quick.json
quick.next_action: Repair local production-debug wiring or keep cloud validation held with a typed blocker owner.

full.description: Run the full runtime quality unit surface.
full.next_action: Repair the failing runtime-quality producer, bridge, consumer, or semantic test before cloud validation.

full.description: Run Scientist, Lex, Fabric, and Foundry unit surfaces.
full.command: uv run pytest tests/unit/scientist tests/unit/lex tests/unit/fabric tests/unit/foundry -q
full.next_action: Repair producer adapter failures or emit typed producer blockers before using live lanes.

full.description: Run evidence-bundle inspection and readiness repo-quality gates.
full.next_action: Repair bundle inspection/readiness findings or classify them as typed blockers with owners.

full.description: Run public export and docs lifecycle repo-quality gates.
full.next_action: Repair public/docs truthfulness or hold rollout until projection surfaces preserve closeout truth.

full.description: Run semantic gold-card and false-pass evaluation pack gates.
full.next_action: Repair semantic false-pass coverage before declaring local validation green.

full.description: Run W11.E compilation truthfulness over the universal outcome corpus.
full.next_action: Repair W11.E missed, hallucinated, scope-drift, or authority-drift obligations before using W12 rollout evidence.

full.description: Run W11.F domain coverage breadth over the universal outcome corpus.
full.next_action: Repair W11.F domain graph coverage or mark uncovered domains as research-only/held before rollout.

full.description: Run W11.F critic ensemble diversity over universal critic fixtures.
full.next_action: Repair critic monoculture or classify the diversity warning before promotion beyond governed pilot.

full.description: Run Phase 7 capability graph export, PROV, inspection, and card gates.
full.next_action: Repair DCAT/PROV/card/inspection generation before treating the capability graph as externally inspectable.

full.description: Run the local production-debug quick path before cloud lanes.
full.command: uv run --extra runtime --extra multi-tenant --extra ml python tools/quality/testing/local_prod_debug_probe.py --repo-root . --checks quick,production-data-static,docs-repro --output _build/.tmp/production-quality/universal_pdc_local_quick.json
full.next_action: Repair local production-debug wiring or keep cloud validation held with a typed blocker owner.

metric_policy.structural_commitment: closeout honesty and useful-design capability are reported separately; typed blockers are diagnostics, not capability success

pattern_pass.target_correct_pattern: Local validation is an executable command-evidence producer with typed blockers, owners, next actions, W11.E/W11.F command evidence, and separate capability metrics.
